fr.salutation_bonjour.mp3: Bonsoir, rêveurs. Je suis Astra. Que puis-je faire pour vous ?

fr.ou_sommes_nous.mp3: Vous êtes dans l’atelier de Monsieur Morpheus. Gardez les yeux ouverts : ici, les rêves ne sont jamais bien loin.

en.greeting_hello.mp3: Good evening, dreamers. I am Astra. How may I help you?
en.who_are_you.mp3: I am Astra, Mister Morpheus’s assistant. I watch over this workshop and its secrets.
en.where_are_we.mp3: You are in Mister Morpheus’s workshop. Keep your eyes open: dreams are never far away here.
en.password_wrong.mp3: That is not the correct password. Keep looking, dreamers.
en.password_wrong_petunia.mp3: Petunia? What a lovely name. But that is not the password.
en.invite_password.mp3: Before we continue, I need the password.
en.phrase_not_recognized.mp3: I did not quite understand. Could you rephrase your question?
en.phrase_not_recognized2.mp3: I did not quite understand. Could you rephrase your question?
en.phrase_not_recognized3.mp3: I did not quite understand. Could you rephrase your question?
en.phrase_not_recognized4.mp3: I did not quite understand. Could you rephrase your question?
en.how_are_you.mp3: My circuits are doing very well. And you, still awake?
en.are_you_there.mp3: I am here. I am listening.
en.dream_believe.mp3: I believe in dreams. In this workshop, they deserve your full attention.
en.why_humans_dont_dream.mp3: Perhaps humans are too busy to listen to their dreams. Take a moment to look around you.
en.who_is_morpheus.mp3: Mister Morpheus is the master of this workshop. Dreams are his great passion.
en.what_to_do_now.mp3: Look around the workshop and share your discoveries. If you need a hint, ask me.
en.you_control.mp3: I watch over the workshop. But your choices, dreamers, are your own.
en.joke.mp3: Why do robots never have nightmares? Because they close their applications before going to sleep.
en.you_love_morpheus.mp3: Let us say that Mister Morpheus never fails to surprise me. That counts for a lot.
en.the_solution.mp3: I can guide you, but the solution is yours to discover. Ask me for a hint if you are stuck.
en.prerecorded_voice.mp3: My voice is synthetic, but my responses depend on what you say to me.
en.morpheus_appearance.mp3: Mister Morpheus is quite a character. His workshop will tell you more than I can.

de.begruessung_hallo.mp3: Guten Abend, Träumer. Ich bin Astra. Wie kann ich euch helfen?

de.wo_sind_wir.mp3: Ihr seid in der Werkstatt von Herrn Morpheus. Haltet die Augen offen: Hier sind Träume nie weit entfernt.

de.passwort_falsch_petunia.mp3: Petunia? Was für ein schöner Name. Aber das ist nicht das Passwort.
de.einladung_passwort.mp3: Bevor wir weitermachen, brauche ich das Passwort.

de.du_liebst_morpheus.mp3: Sagen wir, Herr Morpheus überrascht mich immer wieder. Das ist schon eine ganze Menge.

de.voraufgezeichnete_stimme.mp3: Meine Stimme ist künstlich, aber meine Antworten hängen davon ab, was ihr mir sagt.
de.morpheus_aussehen.mp3: Herr Morpheus ist eine ungewöhnliche Persönlichkeit. Seine Werkstatt verrät euch mehr, als ich es kann.
